title: paeonia mascula subsp. triternata
intro: Paeonia mascula subsp. triternata, commonly known as the Himalayan peony or Tibetan peony, is a plant species within the Paeonia genus. It is native to the Himalayan region and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant's roots and rhizomes are rich in bioactive constituents, including paeoniflorin, paeonol, and paeonillin, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia mascula subsp. triternata have been used to treat various health conditions, including pain management, fever reduction, and digestive issues, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
